editorial.blurb: Zam-Zam is a warm, welcoming Middle Eastern spot in Wrigleyville where attentive staff and thoughtfully prepared dishes—from tender chicken shawarma to perfectly charred lamb chops—make every visit feel special.
editorial.insiderTip: Order the chicken kabob and allow the full 20 minutes for it to cook—the kitchen takes pride in their slow-fire technique, and arriving during off-peak hours means shorter waits without sacrificing quality.

topDishes.note: Juicy, flavorful, and worth the 20-minute cook time
Tender, perfectly seasoned with fresh sides and garlic sauce
Beautiful presentation and cooked with genuine care
